preservation: All five37 Definition sections preserve their exact procedure text. Both40 procedures retain same spaces, projections, signs, start mode, gate order, repeated controlled powers, schedule, outputs and resource caveats, now in explicit Definition/Input/Output/Instructions. All substantive algorithm property arguments moved into matching existing ordinary results, with their supplier Facts/deps, preserving original theorem guarantees and adding explicit well-definedness clauses. Only duplicate controlled-correctness two-step proof removed after its moved richer three-step proof establishes same exact block action, unitarity and scratch cleanup; added coherent linearity sentence. Dual-evaluator moved proof uses the supplied A>=max(C0,C1,1), rather than silently resetting the supplied parameter. Added actual pi-bounds premise for existing64/pi>20 tail comparison.
proof_ownership: Each algorithm proof is not-applicable and justified_by its matching result; results depend on algorithms, without adding reverse deps. No new IDs or helper carriers. The proofs were not hidden in Remarks.
